note: The Granite Ridge gondola: a detachable two-track ropeway from the tree village up to the Granite Ridge launch and the cirque rim. Stations are authored; towers are sited by shared/activities/gondola.js against the ground and the world's solids and crowns, so every client and test sites the same line. Cabins loop at constant speed and creep around each bullwheel for dwell_s, which is when riders board and step off.
